div.head: Episc 10
div.ab: ⁊ sacerdum gebyreþ eac on heora scriftscirum, þæt hi georne to rihte æthwam fylstan ⁊ na geþafian, gif hi hit gebetan magan, þæt ænig Cristen man oðrum derige ealles to swyðe, ne se maga |þam unmagan, ne se hearra þam heanran, ne se scirman his gingran, ne se hlaford his mannum, ne forðan his nydþeowan.

And it is likewise proper for priests in their parishes that they readily assist each person to obtain justice and never permit, if they can correct it, any Christian to inflict injury on another all too greatly, neither the strong on the weak, nor the higher on the lower, nor the shire official on his inferior, nor the lord on his men, nor even his slaves.

Et sacerdotibus pertinet in sua diocesi, ut ad rectum sedulo quemcunque iuuent, nec patiantur, si possint emendare, ut Christianus aliquis alii noceat, nec (non) potens inpotenti, nec (non) summus infimo, nec (non) prelatus minoribus (subditis), nec (non) dominus hominibus suis, nec etiam seruis suis (aut liberis molestus existat).
